about: Tracked peer-reviewed publications of one NASA science mission (id is the site mission ID), from Science Mission Impact by The Planetary Society. Columnar: each key in columns is an array of rows values, and one index is one paper in every column. Sorted by lifetime citations, most cited first, then bibcode. null means unavailable or outside the Active Mission Window, never zero; curated is 1 for a paper added by human-reviewed curation rather than returned by the query. The dictionary defines every column the CSV exports share; citations is exported as lifetime_citations.
